solarpunk botanist, near-future, rendered as cinematic photoreal concept art moodboard, a filmic grade, cracked dry clay

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast. Lighting reference: bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
